name: Detect Operating Mode
summary: Adversaries may gather information about a PLCs or controllers current operating mode. Operating modes dictate what change or maintenance functions can be manipulated and are often controlled by a key switch on the PLC (e.g., run, prog [program], and remote). Knowledge of these states may be valuable to an adversary to determine if they are able to reprogram the PLC. Operating modes and the mechanisms by which they are selected often vary by…

analytics.name: Analytic 1900
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol requests specifically targeting mode/status registers from a source not in the approved control server or engineering workstation list, where the request pattern is narrowly focused on mode/state data rather than broader process value polling. Directly documented in the Triton attack chain's 'Get Control Program Status' request. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone.
